notes: Shooter: guns, kills, respawns and a most-kills timer, with the author settling it as a compact 6-player free-for-all. Arena Deathmatch was the closest preset by mode, but a free-for-all has no team traffic to channel so its lane-network went, and its weapon and armour spawns contradict an economy where you own weapons out of coin-bought boxes, so with the shape swapped and most of the options gone I recorded it as built from scratch rather than claim the preset. space-bounded from the shared catalogue is the arena the prompt actually describes — one bounded single-level fighting space — and it keeps the build on P0; I kept path-loop because an arcade free-for-all wants interconnected routes rather than dead ends, and cover-los because the author asked for clear practical cover in a military arena. With no user to ask I assumed spawn-protected scattered respawn points rather than two mirrored bases, since players respawn continuously in a tight arena, and treated the coins, weapon boxes and 2:30 timer as economy and match rules that do not change the map.
